title: From Brewing to Resolution: Tracing the Internal Lifecycle of Code Reasoning in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2606.17648v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Standard accuracy metrics cannot explain why LLMs handle variable tracking but fail on semantically equivalent loops. We study an internal lifecycle of code reasoning in which models first brew the answer, making it linearly recoverable many layers before it becomes self-decodable, and then diverge into one of four resolution outcomes: Resolved, Overprocessed, Misresolved, or Unresolved. Understanding this lifecycle matters because similar task accuracies can mask fundamentally different failure modes that surface-level evaluation cannot detect. We introduce a dual diagnostic framework pairing layer-wise linear probing with Context-Stripped Decoding (CSD) and apply it to six code-reasoning task families across 16 models spanning Qwen, Llama, and DeepSeek architectures. translated_title: 从酝酿到决断：追踪大语言模型代码推理的内部生命周期
translated_abstract: 标准的准确率指标无法解释为什么大语言模型能够处理变量追踪，却在语义等价的循环上失败。我们研究了代码推理的内部生命周期：模型首先“酝酿”答案，使其在变得可自我解码之前的许多层就已经线性可恢复，随后分化为四种决断结果之一：已决断、过度处理、误决断或未决断。理解这一生命周期非常重要，因为相似的任务准确率可能掩盖表面评估无法检测到的根本不同的失败模式。我们引入了一个双诊断框架，将逐层线性探测与上下文剥离解码相结合，并将其应用于涵盖Qwen、Llama和DeepSeek架构的16个模型上的六类代码推理任务族。四种结果在每个任务族中都占有相当大的比例：总体而言“已决断”仅占41.5%，多个任务低于30%。对结构、深度等因素进行的受控扫描……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出结合逐层线性探测与上下文剥离解码（CSD）的双诊断框架，揭示了LLM代码推理从“酝酿”到“决断”的内部生命周期——答案远早于可自我解码前就已线性可恢复，且总体真正解决率仅41.5%，其余隐藏的过度处理、误决断和未决断等失败模式是表面准确率无法察觉的。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a dual diagnostic framework combining layer-wise linear probing with Context-Stripped Decoding to trace the internal "brewing-to-resolution" lifecycle of LLM code reasoning, revealing that answers become linearly recoverable many layers before self-decodability and that only 41.5% of outcomes are truly Resolved, with hidden failure modes masked by surface-level accuracy.
